features.name: Core Platform Security
features.description: Console setup, authentication, secret encryption, safe error boundaries, Gateway readiness, configuration reload, and graceful shutdown protect the core platform.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/console-request-security-contract.unit.test.ts tests/features/console-secure-bootstrap.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-lifecycle-drain.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/console-request-security-contract.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/console-secure-bootstrap.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/runtime-observability-removal.e2e.spec.ts --workers=1
features.evidence: 2026-07-13: Console first-run setup creates the administrator with a password only, including on non-loopback listeners. The setup-token environment/configuration surface, lock mode, form field, and API validation were deleted while race-safe single-admin creation remains enforced. Focused unit/real-process E2E, pnpm run verify (62 files/326 tests), and all 9 feature regressions pass.

features.name: Provider Model Management
features.description: Provider credentials, editable API roots, OAuth, connection-scoped health probes across up to three models, sparse unhealthy summaries, durable recovery, complete Provider-listed model discovery, manual overrides, dependency guards, and price synchronization remain supported.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/provider-connection-health.unit.test.ts tests/features/provider-probe-lifecycle.unit.test.ts tests/features/provider-model-capability-sync.unit.test.ts tests/features/console-provider-templates.unit.test.ts tests/features/console-provider-dependency-guard.unit.test.ts tests/features/provider-authenticated-http-safety.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/provider-connection-health.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/provider-probe-lifecycle.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/provider-model-capability-sync.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/console-provider-dependency-guard.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/provider-authenticated-http-safety.e2e.spec.ts --workers=1
features.evidence: 2026-07-13: Provider health is connection-scoped for API keys, OAuth tokens, and Local logical connections. Exact automatic/manual probes try up to three models, sparse unhealthy summaries recover by deletion, delayed retries use 5/10/30/60 minutes, stale snapshots are canceled, and Gateway filters only confirmed unhealthy connections. Focused verification passes 29 unit and 14 database/real-process E2E checks; full verify passes 63 files/333 tests and all 9 feature regressions.

features.name: Virtual Model Routing
features.description: Virtual Models are atomically created with one Route Policy and at least one candidate, reject conflicting known capability values while allowing unknowns, and route with fixed, input-plus-output cost_first, or random ordering, connection filtering, unknown-price fallback, and fallback execution.

features.evidence: 2026-07-13: Gateway fallback keeps network, client, and Provider 5xx failures out of connection health; only credential failures enqueue exact connection probes. Focused verification passes 26 unit and 12 database/real-Gateway E2E checks.

features.name: Gateway Protocol Execution
features.description: Gateway executes Chat Completions, Responses, Messages, and Embeddings with provider header/body transparency, streaming safety, and metadata-only logs.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/gateway-request-hygiene.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-error-fidelity.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-metadata-only-logging.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/v1-gateway-routing.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-request-hygiene.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-error-fidelity.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-metadata-only-logging.e2e.spec.ts
features.evidence: 2026-07-11: All four public protocols, streaming/error fidelity, request-metadata-only logs, and provider smoke E2E pass. Responses requires canonical list input and performs no Codex parameter rewriting or SSE-to-JSON bridging. Gateway strips browser transport headers before Provider dispatch, Provider failures log their complete upstream response, and Claude Code Messages retains its required Agent SDK identity and Subscription headers.

features.name: Agent Access And Limits
features.description: Agent API keys, required Virtual Model grants, atomic creation, explicit Limits enablement, reversible Agent enable/disable, RPM, TPM, token, budget, and concurrency limits are enforced without non-core Agent modes or logging switches.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/agent-management-contract.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-settlement-integrity.unit.test.ts tests/features/refactor-agent-limit-domain-types.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/agent-management-contract.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-settlement-integrity.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/v1-console.e2e.spec.ts
features.evidence: 2026-07-12: Agent creation atomically commits the API key, required Virtual Model grants, default model, Limits switch, and rules. Gateway skips Limits access while the switch is off, preserved rules resume when re-enabled, and disabling/re-enabling restores the same key without deleting configuration or history. Limits list queries and runtime KPIs include only enabled Agents with Limits enabled while Agents management can still restore preserved rules. Focused verification passes 13 unit and 8 database/real-process E2E checks; pnpm run verify passes 62 files/327 tests and all 9 feature regressions pass.
